battle.name: 斯沃爾德戰役
battle.theater: 波羅的海西部厄勒海峽
battle.brief: 斯沃爾德海戰在西波羅的海一帶爆發：挪威王奧拉夫·特里格瓦松率六十餘艘戰船與十一度約姆維京船自波美拉尼亞返國，遭丹麥、瑞典與拉德雅爾三方聯軍伏擊。他把戰船並排綁成浮動堡壘，長蛇號居中策應，最終寡不敵眾，溺斃海中。卡面羅馬方陣盾為盾牆原典，其互咬原理正是北歐盾陣所承襲者。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 斯沃爾德是三方聯軍圍攻一方王國的典型海戰。北面是挪威王奧拉夫·特里格瓦松率領的挪威王軍，由王的傭兵「王之家臣」、受薪的持盾步兵與國王的貼身衛士組成，並有十一艘約姆維京佣兵船同行；東面是丹麥王斯文·福克貝里的丹麥艦隊，國王親率王室衛隊與丹麥各地徵集的鄉軍；南面是瑞典王「貪食者」奧洛夫·斯霍特康寧的瑞典分隊，多來自斯維頁與奧普蘭；真正最關鍵的一支是挪威本土的反對勢力——拉德雅爾家族，埃里克·哈康松與其弟斯韋恩·哈康松率領海拉哈蘭與莫厄爾的家臣船隊。拉德系自哈康·西居爾松時代便以丹麥為靠山，埃里克娶了奧洛夫之女為妻，聯姻與封主關係把三方綁在一起。傳記另提到基輔的奧爾加夫人曾派兵欲援奧拉夫而中途被攔截，但此說互相矛盾，可靠性遠低於冰島與挪威兩系薩迦。作戰體系上，雙方都是北大西洋式的海軍：每條船即一個作戰單位，王船為中軍，分船為分隊，划槳手按槳位編組，槍矛手居中，弓手與盾手分列兩舷，接近敵船時再合成接舷的戰鬥隊形。
countriesEn: Three coalitions converged on a single Norwegian king at Svolder. Olaf Tryggvason fielded the royal household of Norway — paid thegns, shield-bearing infantry and a close guard — together with eleven ships of Jomsvikings in mercenary service. Denmark's contingent was led by King Svein Forkbeard with his royal guard and the levy of the Danish districts; Sweden's came under Olof Skötkonung, drawn largely from Svear and Uppland. The most decisive body, however, was Norwegian: the Lade jarls Eirik Håkonsson and his brother Svein Håkonsson, with the war-band of Hálogaland and Møre, men whose family had leaned on Denmark for a generation. Both sides fought in the North Atlantic manner: the king's own ship as the centre of the line, individual ships as tactical units, oarsmen seated bench by bench, spears and axes amidships, bowmen and shield-men along the bulwarks, converting into boarding parties at contact. Tradition also has Olga of Kiev sending warriors to Olaf's aid, intercepted on the way, but that strand is contradicted elsewhere and rests on far thinner ground than the Icelandic and Norwegian saga tradition.
people: 奧拉夫·特里格瓦松（約958至999或1000年）是本役的受害者，也是北歐基督教化最激進的一位君主：他在基輔受洗、娶俄羅斯公主為妻，歸國後強行拆毀特隆赫姆的異教廟宇，逼迫中部挪威改宗，因此同時得罪北方的拉德系與南方的兩位國王。丹麥王斯文·福克貝里是奧拉夫的妻兄，兩人的婚姻糾纏與斯文另娶「高傲的西格麗德」一段公案，直接導致聯姻失敗與反目。瑞典王奧洛夫·斯霍特康寧號「貪食者」，是北歐最早以王號自居的瑞典君主之一。北方的實際統帥是拉德雅爾埃里克·哈康松：傳記描寫他沉著謹慎，認得每一條挪威長船的船主，並力阻斯文衝動出擊；他的座船名為「鐵鬍子」，正是逐船攻破挪威防線的那一條。挪威方面的關鍵人物還有弓手埃納爾·坦巴爾斯克爾維與射手芬：一箭射中埃里克頭頂的舵柄，又一箭在千鈞一髮間射斷埃納爾的弓，埃納爾嘆道「挪威，國王，從你手中」；折弓之後他棄弓取劍與盾死戰。奧拉夫的同父異母兄弟特隆德與托爾斯坦被俘後遭處決，托里爾·隆金生還。至於那首留下陣亡名單的斯沃爾德詩，傳統上歸於十二世紀的斯奈曼德·斯凱爾霍爾蒂，其寫作年代已距戰役約兩百年。
peopleEn: Olaf Tryggvason (c. 958–999/1000), the loser here, was also the most aggressive Christianiser in the North: baptised at Kiev and married to a Rus' princess, he returned home to smash the pagan cult at Trondheim and pressed the conversion of central Norway, thereby antagonising the Lade jarls in the north and the two kings in the south at once. Svein Forkbeard was his wife's brother, and the tangled marriage affairs — Svein's own broken match with Sigrid the Haughty and Olaf's ill-starred proposal to her — poisoned every attempt at a settlement. Olof Skötkonung, called the Hungry, was among the first Swedish rulers to bear the title of king. The real director of the fight was Jarl Eirik Håkonsson, remembered as cool and cautious, recognising every Norwegian longship and holding Svein back from premature attack; his own ship, the Iron-Beard, was the one that worked along Olaf's line and cleared it. On Olaf's side the hinge was the bowman Einarr Thambarskelfir and the archer Fin, whose shaft split Einarr's bow at the very moment of the draw — 'Norway, king, from thy hands,' the bowman cried — after which he threw the bow aside and fought on with sword and shield. Olaf's half-brothers Trond and Thorstein were taken and killed; Thorir Longchin escaped. The Svolder poem that preserves the roll of the dead is traditionally attributed to Saemundr of Skalholt, writing some two centuries after the event.
kits: 本卡兵器是羅馬方陣盾，但要老老實實說明：公元999年的北歐戰場上，沒有人手上拿著羅馬方陣盾。這種凸面長方盾在公元前3世紀的羅馬共和軍就已定型，帝國時期高約一公尺、寬約半公尺、連盾臍重約六至七公斤，右上角留有投擲標槍的缺口，羅馬軍團用它拼出龜甲陣與連續盾牆；到了公元4世紀，它在歐洲大陸上已讓位給小圓盾，北歐戰士使用的是另一種形制。所以本卡代表的是盾牆的原理原典：防線不靠盾牌多厚，而靠盾緣互咬、人人互相依靠。真正出現在斯沃爾德的裝備是北歐圓盾，木板拼製、直徑約八十五至九十公分，中央有鐵盾臍，外緣包鐵並彩繪。維京長船的舷邊成排懸掛圓盾，構成一道流動的舷牆；船員戴有鼻盔或環盔，身披環甲（古諾斯語稱 gumpur），使用丹麥斧、矛與挪威特有的寬刃矛 atgeirr、弓與箭，以及單刃維京劍。載具是狹長的維京戰船：奧拉夫的長蛇號最為人知，據《阿格利普》記載，其船尾高台有三十兩個划槳位；另有載重的克納與供軍隊渡海的比爾丁。
kitsEn: The card's weapon is the Roman scutum, and it must be said plainly that nobody at Svolder carried one. The convex rectangle was already standard in the Republic of the third century BC, and in the Empire stood about a metre high and half a metre wide, weighing some six to seven kilograms with its boss, with a cut-out at the upper right for the javelin; the legions used it to build the testudo and continuous shield walls. By the fourth century it had been displaced by the small round shield, and the warriors of the North fought with another form entirely. What the card therefore preserves is the principle of the shield wall: a line that holds not because the shields are thick but because their rims bite on one another and each man braces his neighbour. The shields actually present at Svolder were Norse round shields, planked, some eighty-five to ninety centimetres across, with an iron boss, an iron rim and painted decoration. On Viking ships these were hung in rows along the gunwales to make a moving bulwark; the crews wore nasal or spang helmets and ring mail, the Old Norse gumpur, and carried bearded axes, spears, the broad-bladed Norwegian atgeirr, bows and single-edged swords. Their vessels were long war-ships, and Olaf's Ormen Lange is the best known: the Agrip gives its stern deck thirty-two rowing places, with knarr and byrding serving as transports.
tactics: 奧拉夫的戰術選擇是整場戰役的關鍵。他本可利用風帆與槳速脫身，卻拒絕逃走，反而把身邊的船並排綁成一道防線：以鐵鏈與纜索把船身互扣，長蛇號置於中線且船首突出於兩翼之前，槳與桁橫在舷外形成拒馬，使敵軍無法直接靠上，己方高處則可居高臨下以弓矢與投槍壓制，結果是一個浮動堡壘，敵方的人數優勢一時無法施展。敵方由埃里克統一節奏，不急於正面硬撞，而是以密集船隊從各方向同時逼近，強迫奧拉夫逐船應戰；丹麥與瑞典分隊各以自己的盾牆接舷，用斧與矛壓制甲板，弓箭手在兩船之間互射，射手芬正是在這種互射中折了埃納爾的弓。接舷後以跳板連成通道，雙方在舷牆上近身搏鬥，埃里克的鐵鬍子從奧拉夫戰線的最末端切入，逐船清理，直到只剩長蛇號。從裝備原理看，這與羅馬龜甲完全相通：斯沃爾德詩所寫的行列常被視為北歐最早把盾牆當作固定編隊的記載之一，其「盾緣咬住盾緣、寸步不讓」的做法，就是羅馬方陣盾千年後的同構物。另一個教訓來自舵位：舵柄在船尾、伸展在舷外，埃納爾一箭正中埃里克頭頂的舵木，說明防守方最脆弱的點常在指揮與操舵的位置。
tacticsEn: Olaf's choice shaped the whole battle. He could have run under sail and oar, but he refused to flee and instead lashed the ships around him into a single line, chained and roped together, with the Long Serpent in the centre and her bow projecting ahead of the wings; oars and yards lay outboard as a barrier against boarding, while the high deck of the central ship gave his archers and javelin-throwers a plunging fire. The result was a floating fort, and the enemy's numerical advantage could not be used. The coalition moved to Eirik's tempo rather than charging in a body: dense squadrons closing from several directions at once, forcing Olaf to be beaten ship by ship. The Danish and Swedish divisions came alongside behind their own shield walls, pressing with axe and spear, while archers shot across the gap between the hulls — it was in such an exchange that Fin split Einarr's bow. Once grappled, the deck became a plank bridge and the fight was carried hand to hand along the bulwarks, Eirik's Iron-Beard working in from the far end of the line until only the Long Serpent remained. In principle this is the Roman testudo all over again: the ordered ranks described in the Svolder poem are commonly treated as the earliest northern record of the shield wall as a fixed formation, and rim against rim, not giving ground, is the same construction a millennium and a half after the scutum. The other lesson concerns the rudder: the steering oar projected from the stern quarter, and Einarr's arrow struck the wood directly above Eirik's head, showing where a defended ship's weakest point usually lies.
data: 年代與時節：此役一般定於公元999年9月，亦有學者定於1000年9月，差異來自薩迦的編年空隙；2000年9月拉格納·瑟德林德的歌劇《奧拉夫·特里格瓦松》首演，即以戰役一千年為由。艦船數：奧拉夫·特里格瓦松傳記載他擁有六十艘戰船，另有十一艘約姆維京佣兵船；斯沃爾德詩逐一刻出敵方陣亡首領與其座船的名，參戰兩軍合計為數十艘之譜，約當六十至八十艘的量級。人力：長蛇號船尾高台有三十兩個划槳位（據《阿格利普》），同級戰船的划槳手數在三十上下。距離與時間：奧拉夫自波美拉尼亞（文德蘭）遠征返航，北海與波羅的海之間的航程以晝夜計，艦隊須連續多日操舟並在海上過夜；九月已是北歐海戰季節的末端，風向與日照轉差。傷亡：所有來源都不給確切數字，只給名字，詩中點名者十餘位，另有大量未記名者；《梅斯塔》稱此役為北地最有名的一場戰鬥，並特別稱讚長蛇號上的抵抗。戰場位置：亞當·不來梅記於厄勒海峽，冰島傳記記於一座名叫斯沃爾德、無法確認的海島；今人另提出呂根、奧克尼一帶等說法，卡片座標取厄勒海峽一線的中值。
dataEn: Date: the battle is usually placed in September 999, though a good number of scholars put it in September 1000; the opera on Olaf Tryggvason by Ragnar Sodernlin premiered in September 2000 to mark the thousandth anniversary. Ships: the saga of Olaf Tryggvason gives him sixty war-ships, with a further eleven supplied by the Jomsvikings; the Svolder poem lists by name the enemy dead and their ships, and the two fleets together come to a score of vessels on the order of sixty to eighty. Crew: the stern deck of the Long Serpent carried thirty-two rowing places according to the Agrip, and comparable ships seated a few score of oarsmen. Distance and time: Olaf was returning from a raid on Pomerania, and the passage between the North Sea and the Baltic is measured in days and nights, the fleet having to row and sail by night; September is already the end of the northern fighting season, with failing light and shifting wind. Losses: no source gives a number, only names — a dozen or more in the poem and many more unnamed; Mesta calls the battle the most famous ever fought in the northern lands, praising especially the resistance aboard the Long Serpent. Site: Adam of Bremen puts it in the Oresund, the Icelandic tradition in the strait by an island called Svolder whose identity is unknown; Rungen and the Orkneys have since been proposed, and the coordinates on this card take the middle of the Oresund line.
cause: 斯沃爾德並非偶發的海上遭遇，而是北歐權力結構的一次總清算。第一層是挪威本身的分裂與統一：九世紀末哈拉爾·淺髮王雖把挪威捏成一個王國，中央權威卻始終受北部的拉德系與南部的丹麥、瑞典牽制。第二層是宗教：丹麥王哈拉爾·藍牙王改宗基督教並拉攏哈康·西居爾松，後者因拒絕改宗而與丹麥決裂，於是被拉德系與奧拉夫的聯盟推翻。奧拉夫·特里格瓦松即位後以軍力強推基督教、拆毀特隆赫姆的偶像廟，把中部挪威的鄉村勢力推向自己對面。第三層是聯姻與外交：向「高傲的西格麗德」求婚受挫、又迎娶斯文之妹蒂莉，兩段婚姻都成了外交破口，使三方把彼此視為必須對付的障礙。最後是航路與物資：斯堪的納維亞的木料、鐵、琥珀與毛皮線，誰控制挪威的峽灣、漁場與波羅的海的出入口，誰就能向南方徵稅；斯沃爾德的海域正是這些航道交會處，奧拉夫的遠征編隊返航時被截，衝突因而不可避免。
causeEn: Svolder was no chance encounter at sea but a general reckoning with the North European order of power. First, Norway's fragmentation: Harald Fairhair had forged a kingdom in the late ninth century, yet its centre remained at the mercy of the Lade jarls in the north and of Denmark and Sweden in the south. Second, religion: Harald Bluetooth's conversion had carried Haakon Sigurdsson with him, and their quarrel over faith broke the alliance, leaving Haakon ripe for overthrow by the jarls and young Olaf. Once crowned, Olaf pushed Christianity by force, destroyed the idol temple at Trondheim and made the rural districts of central Norway his enemies. Third, marriage and diplomacy: the rejected proposal to Sigrid the Haughty and the wedding to Svein's sister Thyri turned two attempts at settlement into ruptures and made each party a problem the others had to remove. Last, the routes and the cargo: timber, iron, amber and furs moved down the Scandinavian coasts, and whoever held the Norwegian fjords, the fishing grounds and the exits into the Baltic collected the toll. Svolder lay where those lanes crossed, and Olaf's expedition was caught on its way home, so the collision was not an accident but a convergence.
impact: 此役的直接後果是挪威王權的崩解：維肯地區歸丹麥王斯文·福克貝里，其餘由拉德系的埃里克·哈康松與斯韋恩·哈康松分治，挪威在名義上淪為丹麥與瑞典的附庸，直到1015年奧拉夫·哈拉爾德松自基輔率兵返國奪位，並於1030年戰死於斯提克勒斯特，才把這一局面翻轉。拉德系的統治延續近一個世紀，期間芬蘭與愛沙尼亞方向的東向擴張，以及北歐對俄羅斯與草原的貿易，都在這一格局下展開，因此斯沃爾德也常被視為北歐海外帝國的起點。文化上的影響更大：它成了北歐英雄敘事的定型事件——埃納爾折弓、奧拉夫沉入海中與「王未死」的傳說，構成後世詩歌的核心母題；相關作品從中世紀的薩迦與組詩，到法羅民謠《奧爾穆林長蛇》（約1830年由耶爾斯·克里斯蒂安·久胡斯所作）、1772年諾爾達爾·布倫的戲劇《埃納爾·坦巴爾斯克爾維》、1863年朗費羅的《奧拉夫王薩迦》，再到2000年的歌劇，延續了千年以上。武器史方面，斯沃爾德常被當作北歐盾牆戰術的標誌性案例，與羅馬方陣盾的龜甲同列。
impactEn: The immediate effect was the break-up of the Norwegian royal authority. Viken went to Svein Forkbeard, the rest was divided between Eirik Hakonsson and Svein Hakonsson of Lade, and for a while Norway was a client of Denmark and Sweden; only when Olaf Haraldsson returned from Kiev in 1015 — to be killed at Stiklestad in 1030 — was the settlement reversed. The Lade rule lasted close to a century, and the eastward drive into Finland and Estonia and the northern trade with Rus and the steppe both unfolded inside that framework, so that Svolder is often treated as the beginning of the North European overseas empire. Its cultural afterlife is larger still: the split bow of Einarr, the king going down into the sea and the rumours that he was not dead became the fixed subject-matter of northern heroic verse, from the medieval sagas and rimur cycles to the Faroese ballad Ormurin langi (Jens Christian Djurhuus, about 1830), Johan Nordahl Brun's play Einar Tambarskjelve of 1772 and Longfellow's The Saga of King Olaf of 1863, down to the opera of 2000. In the history of arms, Svolder is regularly cited as the classic northern case of the shield wall, ranked beside the Roman testudo.
result: 聯軍完勝，但戰果並非均分。挪威王奧拉夫·特里格瓦松陣亡，長蛇號被埃里克·哈康松奪走；斯沃爾德詩逐一刻出陣亡者名單，包括哈康家族與斯基亞家族的數位首領，奧拉夫的同父異母兄弟特隆德與托爾斯坦被俘後遭處決，埃納爾·坦巴爾斯克爾維在詩中被列為陣亡者、在散敘傳記中則有生還的說法。挪威隨即被三分：斯文·福克貝里取得維肯，即丹麥勢力最深的南部；「貪食者」奧洛夫取得特隆赫姆四區及莫厄爾、羅姆達爾、蘭里克，交由女婿斯韋恩·哈康松管治；其餘由埃里克·哈康松治理，成為挪威北部事實上的統治者。外交上，丹麥藉此確立對挪威的宗主地位，瑞典在半島中部與北端取得基地，北歐第一次出現以聯合作戰壓制海上王國的實例。海上的實際結果是：奧拉夫的六十餘艘戰船連同十一艘約姆維京船幾乎全數易手，北歐航線的秩序改由三方聯盟書寫。
resultEn: The coalition won outright, though the spoils were not shared evenly. King Olaf Tryggvason was killed, and the Long Serpent was taken by Eirik Hakonsson. The Svolder poem names the dead, among them several chiefs of the Hakon and Skirja families; Olaf's half-brothers Trond and Thorstein were captured and executed, while Einarr Thambarskelfir is listed among the fallen in the poem and is given a survivor's role in the prose sagas. Norway was then divided three ways: Svein Forkbeard took Viken, the southern district where Danish influence had always been deepest; the Hungry Olof received four districts of Trondheim together with More, Romsdal and Rankrike and handed them to his son-in-law Svein Hakonsson to hold; the rest was governed by Eirik Hakonsson, who became the de facto ruler of northern Norway. Diplomatically, Denmark confirmed its overlordship of Norway and Sweden gained bases in the middle and north of the peninsula, and the North saw its first instance of a coalition war crushing a sea power by sea. The concrete naval result was that Olaf's sixty-odd ships and the eleven Jomsvikings ships changed hands almost entire, and the ordering of the northern sea lanes was henceforth written by the three allied crowns.
